method.C2_label_resolution: User semantic label '联合' identifies S22 C4. C2 is FP sign reversal and separately compared with C0 and C1.

ipd.reason: IPD P1 has B0 with C0 but lacks complete raw/reversed score rows. P2 is the complete B1 pool.

method.AP: Official BOP24 AP (MSSD/MSPD mean); read cached official geometry/matches. Same score ordering and unique clone identities for repeated images, consistent with 33-23.
method.averaging: five datasets equally weighted for image intervals; eligible datasets equally weighted for scene intervals, report corresponding AP points
method.fallback: Report both BCa and percentile. When both miss the point report paired leave-one jackknife SE and normal interval. Use scene jackknife at >=5 scenes, otherwise image; pooled equal-weight jackknife treats each dataset as a stratum at its available unit.
method.primary: Fixed BCa for RC1 and RC2. Also report residual noncoverage if an available percentile interval or requested normal fallback is shown alongside BCa.
method.RC1: entire interval < -10 pp: greatly reduces; entirely in [-1,+1]: equivalent; entire interval > +1: improves; otherwise indeterminate
method.RC2: number of differences whose primary interval excludes their points, by mode and scope

image.outside_explanation: The bias and acceleration adjusted endpoint quantiles remain on one side of the observed estimate.
image.outside_both_explanation: The bias and acceleration adjusted endpoint quantiles remain on one side of the observed estimate. The percentile interval also falls to one side of the full-sample estimate; the signed bootstrap median shift is reported above.
